meta.name: gstack-document-release
meta.description: GStack release documentation method for changelog, release notes, announcement copy, and internal/external release communication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成变更日志、发布说明和公告文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为软件版本生成规范的发布文档和沟通文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate changelogs, release notes, and announcement copy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce standardized release documentation and communication copy for software versions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据变更生成发布文档，包括更新日志、发布说明、公告文案以及内外部沟通内容。
howto.when: 当变更准备好写发布说明，或需要结构化发布沟通，或用户明确要求使用 $gstack-document-release 时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成这次更新的发布说明。
say.note: Claude 会产出用户可见和内部备注。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate release documentation from changes, including changelog, release notes, announcement copy, and internal/external communication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a change is ready for release notes, or structured release communication is needed, or the user explicitly invokes $gstack-document-release.

say_en.text: Generate release notes for this update.
say_en.note: Claude will produce user-facing and internal notes.
